description: Lists the projects in the connected VEDUTUM account with id, client, whether the floor plan has been read, last change, and the points left. Use first when the person talks about one of their projects, to find its id.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

limit.description: Number of projects, default 20, newest change first

name: vedutum_list_projects
title: List my VEDUTUM projects
